grammar_focus: 复习 KS14/38/62 过去完成时 vs 过去完成进行时(方案B换情节包):had done(过去的过去、已完成)与 had been doing(持续到过去某点)的构成与辨析,以及与 before/after/when/by the time 的搭配,后发生的动作用一般过去时
scene: 等我们到公园时,风已经变得很强了。我们盼着放这只新风筝盼了一整周。风筝是里奥自己做的,他还给它上了两天的色。我们还没开始,风就把风筝从他手里扯走了。风筝才飞高了一分钟,线就断了。我们还没来得及去抓,风筝已经飞过树梢不见了。我们到处找,可它早已落在了远处的一片田野里。一个小女孩捡到了它,一直小心地抱着。她一直在等有人回来找它。等我们到家时,我们已经交到了一个新朋友——也学会了要抓得更紧!

grammar_card.title: 复习 KS14/38/62 过去完成 vs 过去完成进行
grammar_card.intro: 本课复习“过去的过去”两种时态及其区别:①过去完成 had done——在过去某个时间点之前已经完成的动作(By the time we reached the park, the wind had grown strong);②过去完成进行 had been doing——持续到过去某个时间点的动作,强调“一直在做”(We had been looking forward to it all week);③二者对比:强调“已完成/结果”用 had done,强调“持续过程”用 had been doing;④常配 before / after / when / by the time,后发生的那个动作用一般过去时(…before the string broke)。

rows: By the time we arrived, the wind had grown strong.
过去完成进行 had been doing
We had been looking forward to it all week.
It had been flying (过程) … had disappeared (结果).
后发生的动作用一般过去
It had been flying for a minute when the string broke.

specialRules.rule: 美语“足球”说 soccer(英式 football);“运动鞋”说 sneakers(英式 trainers)。本课已按美语写。
过去完成看“过去某点之前是否已完成”,过去完成进行强调“持续到那个点”;两件事里先发生的用过去完成,后发生的用一般过去。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What happened when the kite's string broke?
options: The kite flew away over the trees
Leo caught the kite at once

passage: By the time we reached the park, the wind had already grown strong. We had been looking forward to flying our new kite all week. Leo had built it himself, and he had been painting it for two days. Before we even started, the wind had pulled the kite from his hands. It had been flying high for only a minute when the string broke. The kite had disappeared over the trees before we could catch it. We searched everywhere, but it had already landed in a far field. A little girl had found it and had been holding it carefully. She had been waiting for someone to come back for it. By the time we got home, we had made a new friend — and learned to hold on tighter!

与 before/after/when/by the time 的搭配
